expectations.buyer: SMEs selling to public authorities and bid-management or government-sales teams
expectations.pain: Tender discovery, qualification evidence, bid/no-bid decisions, document reuse, portal submission, and compliance consume scarce specialist time
expectations.strongestIncumbent: EU and national tender portals, eProcurement suites, bid consultants, CRM/content libraries, and generative proposal tools
expectations.biggestRisk: Public portals and incumbent suites may absorb the workflow, autonomous submission may be legally or operationally unsafe, and win probability depends on relationships and offer quality rather than document assembly
